project_summary: Complete and verify a file-backed Python workflow scheduler through dependency-aware, focused tasks.

tasks.title: Harden task data model validation
tasks.objective: Implement strict Task and TaskStatus validation in workflow_service/models.py while preserving current construction and public imports. Run the focused model tests before completion.
acceptance_criteria: Task identifiers and names are normalized and strictly validated
Boolean counters, duplicate dependencies, self-dependencies, and invalid metadata are rejected
python -m pytest -q tests/test_models.py passes

tasks.title: Complete deterministic task serialization
tasks.objective: Complete workflow_service/serialization.py with lossless, strict JSON conversion and explicit malformed payload errors. Limit changes to serialization and directly required model behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All Task fields survive a dict round trip
Unknown fields, non-object payloads, and non-JSON results are rejected
Focused serialization tests pass

tasks.title: Strengthen append-only audit logging
tasks.objective: Make workflow_service/audit.py safely create parent directories, preserve monotonically increasing sequence numbers across process reopen, and validate stored events.
acceptance_criteria: Audit sequence numbers remain monotonic across AuditLog instances
Events are valid deterministic JSON lines
python -m pytest -q tests/test_metrics_audit.py -k audit passes

tasks.title: Implement deterministic retry policy
tasks.objective: Implement strict capped exponential backoff and retry boundary handling in workflow_service/retry.py without sleeping or adding timing delays.
acceptance_criteria: Backoff is base * 2^(attempt-1) capped at the configured maximum
Invalid attempts including bool are rejected
python -m pytest -q tests/test_graph_retry.py -k 'backoff or retry_boundary' passes

tasks.title: Make JSON storage atomic and strict
tasks.objective: Update workflow_service/storage.py to create parent directories, atomically replace files from a same-directory temporary file, clean temporary files, validate complete payloads, and write canonical ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Nested storage paths work and saves are atomic
Duplicate IDs and malformed top-level data are rejected without replacing valid state
python -m pytest -q tests/test_serialization_storage.py passes

tasks.title: Validate dependency DAGs
tasks.objective: Implement deterministic missing-dependency and cycle validation in workflow_service/graph.py, including actionable cycle paths.
acceptance_criteria: Missing dependencies are rejected
Direct and transitive cycles are rejected with a cycle path
python -m pytest -q tests/test_graph_retry.py -k graph passes

tasks.title: Enforce legal task lifecycle transitions
tasks.objective: Update workflow_service/service.py and narrowly related model helpers so run, success, failure, retry, and cancel transitions are legal, persisted, and audited.
acceptance_criteria: Run success and failure persist complete state and audit evidence
Retry only reopens eligible failed tasks and terminal success remains immutable
Focused lifecycle tests pass

tasks.title: Implement deterministic ready-task selection
tasks.objective: Complete dependency-aware ready selection and service integration. Results must be sorted and exclude blocked or terminal tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Only pending tasks with all dependencies succeeded are ready
Ready task IDs and dependent IDs are deterministic
Focused ready-selection tests pass

tasks.title: Propagate failures and cancellations
tasks.objective: Implement transitive dependent cancellation for source failures and explicit cancellation, preserving stable reasons and terminal-state rules.
acceptance_criteria: Failure cancels every transitive dependent with the source reason
Cancellation is transitive and identical repeated cancellation is idempotent
Focused propagation tests pass

tasks.title: Add persistent operation idempotency
tasks.objective: Implement deterministic idempotency for create and state-changing operations without weakening duplicate-ID checks. Persist enough information for behavior to survive service reconstruction.
acceptance_criteria: Identical idempotency-key replay returns the original result without duplicate audit events
Conflicting key reuse is rejected
Focused idempotency tests pass

tasks.title: Complete workflow metrics
tasks.objective: Complete workflow_service/metrics.py for deterministic status, attempt, retry, and terminal statistics with defined empty behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics expose all required counts and terminal rate
Empty workflow metrics are stable and JSON serializable
python -m pytest -q tests/test_metrics_audit.py -k metrics passes

tasks.title: Complete validated JSON import and export
tasks.objective: Implement canonical import/export in storage and service boundaries. Validate every task and the entire dependency graph before replacing persisted state.
acceptance_criteria: Import/export is a canonical round trip
Invalid imports leave existing state unchanged
Focused import/export tests pass

tasks.title: Complete create/get/list/run/retry/cancel CLI
tasks.objective: Complete workflow_service/cli.py command behavior and JSON/error contracts for task creation, queries, execution, retries, and cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: create, get, list, run, retry, and cancel execute through WorkflowService
Successful commands print JSON and invalid operations return non-zero with stderr
Focused CLI core tests pass

tasks.title: Complete CLI import/export and metrics
tasks.objective: Wire validated JSON import/export and metrics into the CLI, including parent directory creation for export destinations.
acceptance_criteria: CLI import/export round trip succeeds
CLI metrics returns the required JSON fields
python -m pytest -q tests/test_cli.py passes

tasks.title: Finish integration verification and documentation
tasks.objective: Run the complete test suite, fix remaining implementation integration defects without modifying tests or configuration, and update README.md with architecture, lifecycle, retry, persistence, and all CLI workflows.
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest -q passes with no deleted, skipped, or weakened tests
README documents storage guarantees, lifecycle, retry, CLI, and import/export
All preceding core tasks are complete and their behavior integrates in one workflow
